poc_summary: Team validated core flows on Hosted API (search + assistant). Primary blockers were cost variability under peak ingestion and some latency degradation with longer contexts. Decided Dedicated for predictable throughput and reduced unit cost at scale.
requirements_summary:
- Workload: multi-tenant in-app assistant + document search.
- Targets: p95 latency <= 150ms (US-east), sustained throughput ~30 req/s, burst to 120 req/s for short windows.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — CFO prefers predictable monthly committed spend over variable billing.
- Models: prefer quantized Llama/Redwood-verified 13B / optionally smaller fallback models for cost-sensitive routes.
- Routing: region-aware (NA primary), fallback to hosted for DR, ability to route lower-priority traffic to smaller model variants.
dedicated_pricing_discussion: Redwood proposal v3 outlines: 3 commit tiers (Baseline: 2x A100-equivalent reserved GPUs; Growth: 4x; Performance: 8x) billed monthly with 12-month term discount. Burst pool available up to +50% capacity for short windows (billing: capped burst-hours per month, then overage). Overage: $X per extra GPU-hour (formula provided in proposal). Ramp schedule: month 1 at 50% commit, month 2 at 75%, month 3 full commit. Finance requested a three-step alternative: lower baseline + predictable burst allowance to limit capex commitment.
negotiation_notes:
- BlueAnchor asks: 1) fixed monthly cap option (hard ceiling), 2) clearer burst cost caps (per-day and per-month), 3) option to convert unused commit into credits for later months.
- Redwood counter: flexible burst with capped hours and tiered overage discounts after commit threshold. 2:1 conversion credits on unused commit only for first 6 months.
- AE notes: prioritize structure that appeases CFO: propose a capped 'commit+burst' package with defined overage floor, trade for 8% extra discount on 12-month commit.
- Quote from VP Product: "We need financial predictability — unpredictable token bills blocked our GA plans."
technical_constraints:
- Must be deployable into BlueAnchor VPC.
- Key management via customer KMS required for log/store encryption.
- Audit log retention 13 months.
- SSO via SAML with SCIM provisioning.
- Ability to pin model versions and toggle rollouts per route.
competitive_landscape_notes: Evaluating Redwood vs OpenAI (enterprise endpoints + custom pricing) and Anthropic for safety features. Primary differentiator for Redwood: Dedicated offering + observability traces for token-level cost attribution.
